local_review.finding_body: The test project's `build.gradle` pinned `com.netflix.graphql.dgs:graphql-dgs:10.5.0`. That tied the suite's companion DGS module to the initial tested release instead of allowing the shared test to follow later tested versions, violating the version-agnostic test requirement in §FS-test-contract.2.5 and Review Signal #4.
local_review.finding_title: Version-pinned companion artifact in generated test project
local_review.fix_note: Changed the companion `graphql-dgs` dependency to use the TCK-resolved `$libraryVersion`, keeping it aligned with the tested `graphql-dgs-spring-graphql` version. The exact Forge-owned finalization command then completed successfully and made no additional publishable change.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff, test source and build configuration, metadata file shape, index, and resolved statistics. The tests exercise public DGS behavior from a separate package without scaffold code, native-image skips, reflection shortcuts, or unsupported-runtime tolerance. The reported dynamic-access result is the valid 0/0 no-calls case, so no percentage or entry-count mismatch gate applies. After the repair, the exact Forge finalization command passed all three native test lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and library-statistics generation without further publishable changes.
